role.en: A copper deposit from Arizona, again under a declared scenario. Scale check.
role.es: Un yacimiento de cobre de Arizona, tambien bajo escenario declarado. Prueba de escala.

instance.licence: MineLib, academic download only; aggregate results committed, never per-block data

bound.joint_skipped: time-expanded graph is 141,530 nodes and 2,325,157 edges, above the 130,000/1,400,000 budget. Pricing would be fast, but the bound is only worth reporting once it has been CERTIFIED by one exact solve, and that solve is the pure-Python max-flow. Algorithm 4's certified but looser bound is used

skipped_methods.sliding-window: sliding window needs 12154 candidate blocks to fill the capacity of periods 0..3 and cand_max is 1500. Raise cand_max (the sub-problem is a MILP over cand_max x 4 binaries) or skip this rung

ensemble.replanningNote: A LOWER bound on the expected value of perfect information, not EVPI: the per-realisation re-solve is itself a heuristic, so this understates by whatever that heuristic loses.
ensemble.note: SYNTHETIC geological uncertainty: a seeded lognormal multiplicative perturbation of the block values with a spatially correlated field, NOT a conditional simulation with drillhole data behind it.

expectedTime.refuted: core_halo: 80/108 of training cases fail, 36/54 held out; layered: 0/108 of training cases fail, 0/54 held out; porphyry: 2/108 of training cases fail, 0/54 held out; vein: 6/108 of training cases fail, 3/54 held out. The failures concentrate in core_halo, and they do so on BOTH splits, which is what the first and much narrower sweep could not show: with five scenarios running rate and capacity together at a correlation of -0.735, the scenario looked like the cause and the orebody looked refuted.
expectedTime.split: by deposit seed, never by row

bound.split: by deposit seed, never by row
bound.monotone_note: more capacity cannot lower an LP bound and a higher discount rate cannot raise it. Measured per held-out deposit by holding everything else and sweeping one feature.

learned.honesty: Neither model certifies anything. The certified bound comes from the critical multiplier algorithm or from Bienstock-Zuckerberg; these are scored against the exact quantity they approximate, on deposits they never saw, split by deposit seed.

guard.note: measured on a THIRD disjoint seed set that had no part in choosing the rule. The held-out set that did choose it reported recall 1.00; this is the number that was not chosen on. Where the exact plan is in the same bake the product shows the MEASURED ratio instead of this rule.

flags.detail: total capacity 152,432,304 is below the model tonnage 222,720,060: the plan will not mine the whole ultimate pit within the horizon
